lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is a joint HARC and P&Z special session Monday that will shape how Telluride's Land Use Code and Design Guidelines get rewritten to meet Colorado's Wildfire Resiliency Code — whatever language they land on goes straight to Town Council. Also worth watching: the Telluride Hospital District board meets Thursday to dig into mill levy considerations tied to the long-running push for a new facility, and the Open Space Commission takes up the Perimeter Trail NEPA process and Keystone Gorge signage on Sunday.

notable.stake: Commission recommendations on wildfire code changes go directly to Town Council.
Mill levy discussion could shape how the hospital district funds a new facility.
NEPA update and trail decisions affect public land access and open space priorities.
